arguments.text: Great start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, ease off.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod CP ~201 W, uncertain 10-25%), keep pod reserve above ~40% until 2 km to go, then spend it; final sprint from ~600 m. Check CP with heart-rate trend at steady effort (rising HR = above CP). Watch for incidents: weed on rudder (speed drop at same pod power), pod drift (pod power vs boat power diverge), radio course changes, wind shifts.

min 7.6 (454 s): paddler said cooked, 9/10 hurting. Evidence against: HR flat 172 +-1 from 200-430 s at pod 214 W, now dipping to ~172 at 203 W in piece; fade ~0; boat/pod power ratio steady ~0.62 (no pod drift). Judged paddler over-pessimistic; cued reassure. Keep watching HR: if it climbs >1 bpm/min at ~205 W, CP is lower than thought.
